final: WITH pp AS (SELECT p.ID AS ID, p.SEX AS SEX, AVG(e.`aCL IgM`) AS v FROM Examination e JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.ID, p.SEX), om AS (SELECT AVG(v) AS m FROM pp), dv AS (SELECT pp.ID, pp.SEX, pp.v, pp.v - om.m AS dev FROM pp, om), sa AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(dev) AS adev FROM dv WHERE SEX IS NOT NULL GROUP BY SEX) SELECT dv.ID, dv.SEX, dv.v AS `aCL IgM`, dv.dev AS deviation, dv.dev - sa.adev AS excess FROM dv JOIN sa ON sa.SEX = dv.SEX WHERE dv.dev > sa.adev ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
